preferences.title: PREFERENCES
preferences.chat_logs_intro: Logs are written in Firestorm's format, so Firestorm and SLNG can read each other's history: same folder layout, same file names, same lines. To share a history, choose for an account the folder Firestorm uses for it.
preferences.chat_logs_browse_title: Choose the folder for chat logs
preferences.chat_logs_in_effect: In effect (the account's own folder is created inside the folder above): {0}
preferences.chat_logs_no_accounts: No saved accounts yet. Log in once and the account appears here.
preferences.chat_logs_apply_hint: A change applies at the next login.
preferences.chat_logs_relog_notice: Log out and back in to use the new folder ({0}). Until then this login keeps writing to {1}.
preferences.chat_logs_import_hint: Logs written by earlier SLNG versions stay where they are, untouched. This copies them into the folder of the account you are logged in with, appended to the end of the matching files; doing it again adds nothing. It needs a login, because the history belongs to the logged-in account.
preferences.chat_logs_import_needs_login: Log in first: the history is filed under the account you are logged in with.
preferences.chat_logs_import_summary: Found {0} old log file(s): {1} message(s) to import, {2} already there, {3} file(s) skipped.
preferences.chat_logs_import_confirm: Append these messages to the logs in {0}? Old files are not changed or removed, and what is already in the new files is only added to. The old logs were not kept per account, so everything found is filed under the account you are logged in with.
preferences.chat_logs_one_viewer: Do not run Firestorm and SLNG at the same time on the same log folder: each one appends to its files without knowing about the other.
preferences.toolbar_heading: Buttons shown on the bottom bar:
preferences.ui_scale_auto_tip: Uses the scale the operating system has set for the screen this window is on, and follows the window to another screen. Off means the slider below decides, on every screen.
preferences.build_rotation_snap_tip: Angular step the rotate gizmo snaps to, and the spacing of its dial ticks. Leading the cursor out past the dial while turning engages it.
preferences.build_grid_tip: Cell size of the move gizmo's grid and the spacing of its axis ruler. Sliding the cursor off the axis while dragging snaps to these steps.
preferences.hide_own_group_title: Hide my group title from everyone
preferences.hide_own_group_title_tip: Stops the simulator sending your group title to anyone, including you. Unlike the options above this is not a local view setting -- other people really stop seeing it.
preferences.show_group_titles_tip: Shows the active group's title above the name. Local only -- it cannot stop others seeing yours, because the simulator sends it to them.
preferences.show_display_names_tip: Off shows everyone's username instead. The bracketed line below disappears with it, since there is nothing left to tell apart.
preferences.show_legacy_names_tip: Shows the account's unchangeable username in brackets below the Display Name. Avatars without a Display Name are unaffected.
preferences.ui_scale_hint: Scales the whole interface: menus, windows, text and tooltips. The 3D view is not affected. A value set with the slider applies when the slider is released.
preferences.camera_speed_hint: Multiplies the speed of the on-screen Camera Controls pads. 100% is the default.
preferences.camera_view_hint: FOV and focus height apply live; the rear view distance takes effect on the next camera reset (Esc).
preferences.profile_name_prompt: Enter a name for the profile:
preferences.vsync_hint: With V-Sync on, a frame that just misses the refresh deadline waits for the next one, so a client short of 60 FPS reads as a steady 30. Turn it off to see the real frame rate.
preferences.object_detail_hint: How finely mesh objects are drawn. This is RenderVolumeLODFactor from the official viewer — 1.0 is its default. Higher keeps distant objects detailed and costs performance, lower saves triangles. Takes effect over the next second, not instantly.
preferences.licenses_missing: The third-party notice file is missing from this build. This is a licensing problem, not a display one — please report it.
preferences.maturity_blurb: Choose what maturity rating of regions and content Second Life shows you. This has no effect on OpenSim.
preferences.maturity_unsupported: This grid does not support a content-rating preference (OpenSim has no equivalent of Second Life's General/Moderate/Adult system).
preferences.maturity_account_max: Your account is verified up to: {0}
preferences.always_run_hint: Makes the avatar run instead of walk when moving forward.
preferences.seat_pose_overrides_ao: Furniture poses override the AO when seated
preferences.seat_pose_overrides_ao_hint: Only for ordinary furniture, and off by default. While the object you sit on plays a pose, animations from worn attachments are not rendered — which stops an AO stealing a couch's pose, but also breaks pose stands, where the pose comes from a HUD. Local to this viewer; nothing changes for other people and no script is affected.
preferences.play_typing_animation_hint: Plays the typing animation and broadcasts the typing indicator when composing local chat messages.
preferences.head_follows_camera_hint: Turns the avatar's head toward the camera direction for observers in third person. Turn off for neutral forward portrait gaze.

material_lab.title: Material lab
material_lab.intro: Developer tool for A/B comparison against Firestorm. Values are not saved; after a restart the defaults apply again (reflection 1.00, viewer sun highlight on).
material_lab.legacy_specular_hint: Scales the sky/environment reflection of faces with a specular map. With the viewer sun highlight on (default) 1.00 is the viewer's own gloss reflection: none at low glossiness (the terrace floor), growing with glossiness. With it off it scales Godot's own reflection, and 1.00 is the stock look (pale sky veil). Applies to opaque, alpha-mask and alpha-blend faces; avatar and HUD faces are not affected.
material_lab.viewer_spec_hint: Default: on. For opaque, alpha-mask and alpha-blend faces with a specular map, replaces the sun highlight with the reference viewer's own formula (wide Blinn-Phong lobe, tinted) instead of Godot's own highlight, and takes the viewer's gloss-dependent reflection. Off = Godot's highlight, and the reflection slider then scales that.
